title: Declaration-only literal selectors are made opaque based solely on spelling

requirement.expected: PRESERVE genuine selector/type constraint; unresolved dual role UNKNOWN with source/digest/length

implementation_locations.role: Spelling whitelist and replacement of declared type with UNKNOWN
Declaration-only type does not enter runtime-payload index
Catalog emission retains the opaque shape

inert_witness.input_context: An otherwise valid synthetic pinned tree and owner map using the sealed tests' @synthetic/example package and P100-012 owner; this source replaces its types.ts. Described only; not materialized, parsed with TypeScript, imported or executed.
inert_witness.established_role: The literal appears exclusively in an exported TypeAliasDeclaration named Selector. There is no runtime expression, initializer, call or other payload occurrence in this physical source. Its program-looking spelling supplies no evidence of a program-source role.

exact_static_derivation: isCandidate accepts packages/core/example/src/types.ts (254-275); ref.read authenticates its bytes before the TypeScript branch invokes extractTypeScriptContracts (1608-1651).
parseTypeScriptContract builds the source; indexRuntimeLiterals skips type nodes (744-750). With no runtime literal in this source, the source-local payload map has no hash for 'throw 0' (783-785).
visitStatements recognizes the exported type alias, chooses kind 'type' and symbol 'Selector', and calls printed(node.type) (805-810, 847-859).

printed visits its StringLiteral. No executable node exists and the payload-map test is false, but the literal fails /^[A-Za-z0-9_$./:@-]{1,200}$/ because of its space (558-573). It adds the literal hash and UTF-8 length.
The literals.length branch returns UNKNOWN rather than printing the genuine literal constraint (581-585). The exact predicted declaration is provided below.

Record emission wraps it in declarations (960-965). projectIdentity preserves the valid symbol Selector (19-27, 1585-1587); emitFor retains the shape, marks extraction_status UNKNOWN and parity_status NOT_VERIFIED (1592-1605). The generic source-surface entry does not recover the literal constraint (1655-1661).

type.reason: Unclassified literal in a declared type; bytes not copied

output_evidence_kind: Prediction derived from sealed code; no helper/test execution and no captured runtime catalog
impact: The genuine case-B selector's exact value cannot be recovered from the contract shape; only its digest and length remain. This violates the frozen preservation rule even though declaration identity, source, owner and the file-level denominator remain present. It is information loss, not evidence of guest execution or a parity PASS.

regression_gap.detail: The genuine-selector control uses throw/ROLE_R12/, which passes the spelling whitelist. The spaced-name controls at 761-806 test event/tool names through different paths; they do not cover a spaced literal type selector.

recommended_change: Preserve literals with an established declaration-only selector role regardless of spelling, while keeping actual payloads and unresolved same-source dual roles opaque. Add a declaration-only spaced/punctuated selector control and a same-source runtime-payload collision control. Preserve source, owner, requirement identity and NOT_VERIFIED parity.
verification_required_after_fix: A separate authorized implementation round should review the change and run focused synthetic regressions; this audit neither changes nor self-approves the implementation.
